# EXEcify

> EXEcify is an independent browser-based project that builds Windows executables from supported source-code projects.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/): Upload a project and configure a Windows build.
- [Documentation](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/docs.html): Supported languages, project preparation, limits and troubleshooting.
- [Security Center](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/security.html): Upload processing, storage, deletion and known security limitations.
- [Privacy](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/privacy.html): Data handling and third-party service information.
- [Service status](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/status.html): Automated website and Worker/KV health checks.
- [Downloads and verification](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/downloads.html): SHA-256 verification and Windows warning information.
- [About](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/about.html): Project scope and independence.
- [Contact](https://martgeluk11-dev.github.io/contact.html): Support and security reporting.

## Capabilities
- Supported project types include Python, JavaScript/Node.js, TypeScript, C, C++, C#/.NET, Go, Rust and Java.
- Projects can include multiple source files, assets and dependency manifests.
- Current published limits: 150 files, 80 MB total input and 80 MB generated output.
- Builds run on temporary Windows GitHub Actions runners. Upload handling and job state are managed by a Cloudflare Worker.

## Important limitations
- EXEcify is an early-stage independent project, not affiliated with Microsoft or GitHub.
- Builds are not a security scan or safety certification. Generated executables are not currently digitally signed by EXEcify.
- The build environment is not a dedicated micro-VM per job, and outbound network access is not fully disabled.
- Do not upload confidential information, passwords, API keys, private keys or personal data.
- The status page checks Worker responsiveness and its KV binding; it does not verify GitHub Actions runner availability or successful builds for every language.

## Source repositories
- Frontend: https://github.com/martgeluk11-dev/martgeluk11-dev.github.io
- Build backend: https://github.com/martgeluk11-dev/PY2EXEONLINE
